d: Vivek Ramaswamy was meant to be one of Donald Trump’s biggest midterm success stories. Now, a controversial attack ad targeting his Democratic rival Amy Acton has triggered a Republican backlash, drawn criticism from Ohio’s Republican establishment, and put his campaign under intense scrutiny. Trump has defended the ad, but the fallout continues to grow. With the Ohio governor’s race tightening, could Ramaswamy’s gamble become a political liability for the President just days before the midterms? Cary Johnston brings you the details on Firstpost America.
